select.roleError: Please select a role to continue.
select.p2: Called when the selected value changes.
select.p5: Called when the popup open state changes.
select.p8: Marks the select as required in forms.
select.t1: Height, padding, text size, and icon size of the trigger. Large triggers also use 36px menu rows; other sizes use 32px rows.
select.t2: Optional icon displayed before the value.
select.t3: Text shown when no value is selected.
select.t4: Error message shown below the trigger.
select.t5: Additional classes for the trigger wrapper.
select.i0: Position index within the content for proximity hover.
select.i2: Optional icon displayed before the label.
select.c0: Additional classes for the menu container.
select.c2: Popup alignment relative to the trigger.
select.c3: Distance from the trigger along the selected side.
select.c4: Alignment offset along the trigger edge.
